fields.terrain: coastal plain and plateau separated by central mountains
fields.hazards: earthquakes; droughts; occasional cyclonic disturbances from the Indian Ocean bring heavy rains and flash floods; volcanism: experiences limited volcanic activity; Ardoukoba (298 m) last erupted in 1978…
fields.resources: potential geothermal power, gold, clay, granite, limestone, marble, salt, diatomite, gypsum, pumice, petroleum
fields.farm: vegetables, beans, milk, beef, camel milk, lemons/limes, goat meat, lamb/mutton, tomatoes, beef offal
fields.exports: raw sugar, seed oils, cars, palm oil, rice
fields.religions: Sunni Muslim 94% (nearly all Djiboutians), other 6% (mainly foreign-born residents - Shia Muslim, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Baha'i, and atheist)
fields.legal: mixed system based primarily on the French civil code (as it existed in 1997), Islamic religious law (in matters of family law and successions), and customary law
fields.military: 18-26 years of age for voluntary military service
